frozenBefore: any full-band baseline or pilot result was measured
policy: A full-band pilot may only be recommended if it BOTH preserves GuitarSet development performance within the regression gates AND shows the required full-band improvement. Gates are not weakened after results are seen. Failing either half means retaining v1.

domain.p00: sealed; not used for pilot selection
domain.slakhTestSplit: untouched; not used for model selection at any point
domain.compositionGrouping: aligned-MIDI SHA-256; duplicate renderings and alternate views never cross a partition

preservationGatesVsV1GuitarSetDevelopmen.rationale: A full-band model that forgets solo guitar is not an improvement to Tabsmith's actual use case, so GuitarSet regression is a hard gate rather than a reported statistic.

percussionOnlyControl.description: A drums-only signal carries no harmony; a model that invents chords there is hallucinating from rhythm.

cpuOnlyPolicy.rationale: No CUDA is available and one GuitarSet fold already costs roughly 80 minutes on 12 logical cores. A broad search is not affordable and is not attempted; one technically defensible strategy is chosen from the measured baseline bottleneck.
cpuOnlyPolicy.honestPartialReporting: If the pilot cannot finish in the available window it stays resumable and is reported as incomplete with measured progress, never as a result.

reportingRequirements: composition counts and durations reconciled before training
interpretationLimit: Slakh2100 is synthetic (rendered from MIDI). Even a fully passing pilot is synthetic-domain evidence only and does not establish production readiness. A future untouched, real-recorded, legally licensed full-band benchmark remains required.
